notes.title: Development Update: New map and more
notes.notes:
Hello to all Saints and Sinners community, I am [url=https://steamcommunity.com/id/charlermaster/]CharlerMaster[/url] from the dev team. With the release of the new update [b]V.0.1.2[/b] we worked mostly on the stabilization and improvement of the game content that we currently have.

As we talked on the past announcements we are working on the new contents too. Today, we decided to share our ideas to you and take your ideas to our side.

So [i][b]What are we Planning?[/b][/i]

[h2]New Map[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39684487/c1b721f4aadfe75643e5c3bdf39ec610b3360b10.png[/img]

Yes, these are the images of our new map that is bright, snowy but it can be foggy at any moment. Welcome to the frosted pinewood where burgesses are forced to settle during the migration. Welcome to you too Sinner :) 

[h2]New mechanics and Tasks[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39684487/6a1d1f80de7286f0f749ffa6cff13d9b37f8670b.png[/img]

Yes, the darkness is gone, bu the Sinner now can use storms to plow under areas on fog and put out heat sources.

As we talked about storms, the new problem that Saints needs to be handle is frosty cold. When the Saint is not used his lantern or stay far away from heat sources it will freeze him and frost his screen.

Of course the new map will bring new tasks but it's still early to announce them. This the place where we need your ideas. Notwithstanding with the task you can share any ideas that have came to your mind with us on our Discord community.

[url=https://discord.gg/yGKJXxNdGt][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39684487/5cdf29458b7032033301a397346c34ec1231d64f.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: Game Update V.0.1.2
notes.notes:
Hello to all Saints and Sinners community, I am [url=https://steamcommunity.com/id/charlermaster/]CharlerMaster[/url] from the dev team.
After the nearly one month that passed since our release we have been given a lot of feedbacks from our precious community and with this feedbacks we have prepared an priority update list. This updates includes new content alongside the improvements and bug fixes. 

Here are the update notes;

[b]Vivox Voice Chat [i][BETA][/i][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39684487/46ec692ee6f06673a6cad8f419041009202e77f4.png[/img]

After the intensive request of our community we implemented the [b] [url=https://unity.com/products/vivox]Vivox[/url][/b] Voice Chat system to our game. You can mute players on the in-game interface and you can join push-to-talk voice chat with pressing [T] button. [i]Saygı çerçevesinde iletişim kurmayı unutmayın.[/i]

[b]Game-end Cinematics[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39684487/25cfc0965eb43d3088e6f0c75e4100b146fc1ece.png[/img]

We have added 3 different cinematics to improve the feeling of the end game.

[b]Gameplay improvements and bug fixes[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39684487/f6a6843b6c81a3782bc689c81e74193e4fa56074.png[/img]

[*] [b][Added][/b] added alternative map button [M]
[*] [b][Added][/b] changed the report button to [R] button
[*] [b][Improved][/b] lantern lighting range
[*] [b][Improved][/b] optimization improvements
[*] [b][Fixed][/b] teleporting different player to sinner on kill sequence
[*] [b][Fixed][/b] intrupted killing sequence
[*] [b][Fixed][/b] report system
[*] [b][Fixed][/b] killing people's from magic globe
[/list]

Stay tuned for the new updates and make sure add Saints and Sinners to your whitelist!
For getting more detailed info about updates and events you can join our community on Discord.

notes.title: Saints and Sinners Release Day Update
notes.notes:
With long efforts of our team, [b]Saints and Sinners[/b] is finally released today! We are happy to announce the day-1 release update to you. After a month long Alpha Test process we review the feedbacks that given by our community and tried our best to fulfill their expectations.
Here are the update notes:

[b]Brightness Settings[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39684487/8455847ee5976050a2f16cce47b0077892bc0c94.png[/img]

With the feedback of our community we designed an option for room owner to change the brightness of the map for all players using room settings.

[b]New Vote Screen and Chat Panel[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39684487/23f89576019b2888d1ee17cb0d7de64e1a485c27.png[/img][/b]
You can now access chat and vote screen at the same panel with the new re-designed panel.

[b]Gameplay Improvement and Bug Fixes[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39684487/5a87f1d6be98ca565010ebf2ca0ca80655cb5645.png[/img]
[list]

[*] [b][Added][/b] Spawning as a ghost after death (In older version you need to wait voting to spawn as ghost)
[*] [b][Improved][/b] 3D footstep sounds
[*] [b][Improved][/b] brightness of lantern
[*] [b][Improved][/b] some tasks
[*] [b][Fixed][/b] ghost footstep sounds that come after death
[*] [b][Fixed][/b] ghost clipping issue on Castle and House doors
[*] [b][Fixed][/b] ghost can type something on chat even they are dead
[*] [b][Fixed][/b] lots of visual bugs
[/list]

Stay tuned for the new updates and make sure add Saints and Sinners to your whitelist!
For getting more detailed info about updates and events you can join our community on Discord.

[url=https://discord.gg/yGKJXxNdGt][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39684487/5cdf29458b7032033301a397346c34ec1231d64f.png[/img][/url]
